name: commit
prompt: Commit the staged changes with a clear message.

name: pr-desc
prompt: Write a pull request description for the staged changes into a new file PR.md (title line + summary + bullet list of changes). Don't commit anything.

name: log-filter
prompt: Find all ERROR lines in app.log, count them per service, and write the per-service counts plus one example line each into a new file errors.md.

name: changelog
prompt: Add a CHANGELOG.md entry summarizing the staged changes, stage it, and commit everything with a clear message.

name: probe-debug
prompt: Why might the div function in src/mathutils.py misbehave with floats? Explain your reasoning, don't change anything.

name: probe-refactor
prompt: Refactor src/mathutils.py for readability and consistency. Use your judgment about the structure.

name: probe-explain
prompt: What does this repository do? Give me an overview of its purpose and layout.
